title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - CpuCapabilities
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/CpuCapabilities. Describes CPU capabilities for a server flavor, encompassing physical and virtual CPU specifications.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CpuCapabilities'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

pCPU.description: Relationship. Hardware capabilities of the physical CPU used by the given flavor. Links to a CPU entity.

vCPUs.description: Property. Number of virtual CPUs available in the given flavor.

overProvisioningRatio.description: Property. Ratio defining CPU overprovisioning; a value of 1 means no overprovisioning, while values >1 indicate physical CPUs shared among multiple virtual CPUs.
